name: 狂想空间II
english_description: A mudlib derived from the ES II/Annihilator architecture line, a different lineage from the jyqxc family (it uses the driver's native plaintext save format rather than that family's old binary format). A diff against this project's kxkj (#036, "Rhapsody Realm") shows byte-identical master.lpc, securityd.lpc, and death-system files — not an adaptation or sequel, but another independent snapshot of the same 2002 release by Taiwanese wizard wade, differing by only about 10 runtime files. Each archive independently built its own newbie zone under the shared name "Snow Village," with different actual content — evidence of two separately built instances of the same engine source rather than one being derived from the other.
